out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located near the dish washing machine, was observed blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing. a stack of. Dish washing baskets were stored in front of this sink.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the FRONT serving station is being used for dual purposes, hand washing and dumping food debris.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands.Since this hand washing sink is very l;argue in size, install a water proof (stainless steel or plastic divider to create two compartments. One compartment will serve as the hand washing and the other for dumping food debris. This violations has been cited previously, your cooperation in resolving this violation is required. A hand washing sink shall only be used for hand washing. You may install an additional sink for dumping.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: whole milk=46F, oat milk =46F, almond milk=47F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. All were discarded during the inspection.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items.Cleaning chemical bottles were observed stored next to food and single service cups and lids.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. The chemicals were relocated away from food and food contact utensils

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. (CORRECTED) The CFM arrived during the inspection.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the front serving station is being used for dual purposes, for hands washing and washing of small utensils from the Mix Drink Station.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. Since the currently hand washing sinks is oversized, you may install a divider to provide two compartments, and use one compartment for hand washing and the other compartment for holding and rinsing small utensils. The clean ed utensils must be properly. Sanitized before use each time, after cleaning. In the mean time use the sink on Lyft for hand washing.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the at the front serving area was being used to wash smaller utensils and for dumping waste.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at throughout the facility, are only providing hot water tempeature of 84-88F , when tested.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: Unmarked Squeeze bottles and containers holding hard-to- identify foods, were not observed labeled to identify contents. .
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Hot and cold water available, adequate pressure

violations.title: Hot Water Capacity to Meet Peak Demands
violations.observation: The water heater serving the food service establishment is not providing adequate hot water at all of the sinks.
violations.corrective_action: Hot water generation and distribution systems shall be sufficient to meet the peak hot water demands throughout the food establishment. At this time, make repairs or adjustment to meet the peak water demand.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed eating and/or drinking in food prep area, where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. There were no pass passer towels;Les at the hands sink located at the ware washing station.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. (Paper towels were provided during the inspection).

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the are washing station was blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing. Bread basket with personal belongings were at the front of the hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. Items were relocated during the inspection.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. hand washing soap was m,issuing min the soap dispenser, at the hand sink located at the ware washing station.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. (Soap was provided during the inspection).

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: A variety of sauces in squeeze bottles were not properly labeled, to identify products.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. The squeeze bottles were labeled properly, during the inspection.
